about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate) of the perfboard variant. Each counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256, 'electrical' = electrical_sha256, 'layout' = layout_sha256 (the plan with the footprint data), 'fab' = fab_sha256 (the drawings and lists the gate writes into fab/main/). Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (BT1, D1) checked a second time against the datasheet, independently – the agent electrical-reviewer in its own session
manual.note: M-1: OK for state c1ffee3ad4c336ae95011a09732f20567d985552bfbfa2453931050ec9ea7de9; requirements met: R-1, R-2. Changed since da4d9070 (OK there too): the reviewer's notes applied – D1 rs_ohm 8 (p. 5) and VR 5 V from IR ≤ 10 µA at VR = 5 V (p. 3), BT1's lead per pin and height 8.9 mm, the graph's layout note for this holder. R-1: 1.92 mA at used/vf-max against 1 mA; R-2: leakage under 0.05 µA against 1 µA. Notes, none blocking: no moulded '+' on the holder – the clip end is plus; C5365915's open item names this plan's hole; D1's solder joint 2 mm from the epoxy (datasheet p. 3). Datasheets Kinghelm KH-CR2032-2-1 rev F 9b2ef878…, XINGLIGHT XL-504SURD 477fa83a…, read 2026-11-10.

manual.text: Regulatory review: circuit and parts against EU law for the purpose in the graph – the agent regulatory-reviewer in its own session. No finding 'block' open. Support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed
manual.note: M-6: OK for state c1ffee3ad4c336ae95011a09732f20567d985552bfbfa2453931050ec9ea7de9 (electrical fee1183debdfe2f6813758d77e3ee523a5e708f314a7f803394d028f70f1e3f4) and purpose private. Changed since da4d9070 (OK there too): data only (D1 rs_ohm and VR source, BT1 height, sim numbers in texts) – no part, net, purpose, requirement or compliance block. Notes, none blocking: EMC benign by EMVG § 2(3) Nr. 2 (judgement); coin cell removable by hand, adults only (D-5); spent cell to collection (BattDG § 6), board separately at end of life (ElektroG § 10); RoHS stated for all four parts, REACH and the perfboard, wire and solder unstated – no duty for private; no purpose.country, German references; a board given away or sold needs a new M-6. Support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed.

manual.text: The perfboard plan reviewed independently (buildability, mechanics, operation, looks) on the drawings and lists of a gate run with this plan – the agent pcb-reviewer. No finding 'block' open, every 'important' finding fixed or rejected by the owner
manual.note: M-5: OK for fab 34fd75d38a7ef069fc1c6a35b59bb743fa071518c256c591b742b093c3c7dbf4; layout 43bf60f797efe96aa59677d763c85a1dca896ddd40af4cb284c1caf947df7d8a. Gate run 20261110-102800, fab/main/ reviewed in full (top.svg, bottom.svg, cut.svg, build.md). Changed since f684ecb1 (OK there too): cut.svg, the cut list at 1:1 – scale true, its caption asks for 100 %, not fitted, and a ruler check; lengths in whole millimetres, rounded up; no bare wire – the black wire's end stripped 8 mm at N10 runs over M10 onto L10's pad (52 mm, 5 mm stripped at J1), R1's lead in F4 bent onto E4 and D1's anode lead in J3 onto J4 in step 6, both left long and unsoldered in their part's step and cut at the pad's far edge; lengths, strips, holes and the material (red 5 cm, black 6 cm) agree in cut.svg, build list and plan; the bends lead away from J2 (GND), the only neighbouring pair of nets J2–J3 is in the test list; the bottom view's legend says 'bars: bridges, coloured by net'. Notes, none blocking: bend R1's F4 lead slightly in step 1 so R1 stays flat; lay the 8 mm end beside L10's hole until BT1 is in. Still open from before: the metal clip as BT1's +, D1's flange clearance to the GND wire (thin wire), trim the stripped end J1→J2 to J2's pad; the material list names no core diameter (AWG 22–24 fits the 1.0 mm hole).

manual.text: Acceptance test of the soldered board: the test list of build.md, BT1's + end (the metal clip) on hole D10 and D1's anode in J3, D1 lights while SW1 is pressed and is dark once it is released
